# AGENTS.md

## Project Overview
This is a clean TypeScript and React project for testing AgentRuleMap.

## Repository Structure
- `src/index.ts`: Application entrypoint
- `src/utils.ts`: Helper utilities
- `tests/index.test.ts`: Test suite

## Development Setup
Run `npm install` to install dependencies.

## Build Commands
Run the build:
```bash
npm run build
```

## Test Commands
Execute tests:
```bash
npm test
```

## Lint & Quality Verification
Run lint checks:
```bash
npm run lint
```

## Coding Guidelines
Use strict TypeScript types without `any`. Follow modern functional programming conventions.

## Safety Rules
- Never commit `.env` files or credentials.
- Do not bypass verification checks.

## Environment Information
Refer to `.env.example` for required configuration variables.
